title: Figure 5. Thin Shell of (Localized) Mass-Energy with Two Principal Radii of Curvature
description: Wireframe 3D mesh of a curved, saddle-like surface labeled "thin shell of mass-energy", with a line passing through it marked ρ1 and ρ2 for the two principal radii of curvature. Caption: "Figure 5. A Thin Shell of (Localized) Mass-Energy Possessing Two Principal Radii of Curvature, ρ1 and ρ2." Surrounding text gives the surface stress-energy tensor equation (2) and equation (3a).
